items.title: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) Tightens Rules On External Generative AI Models

Alongside Nvidia and Booz Allen, the firm has introduced stricter controls on external AI tools to address data security and safety concerns. Palantir now requires zero data retention guarantees before Anthropic’s models can be integrated into its enterprise and government solutions.
